column1: # HgrmMediaPlayerApp per-model feature table: 55 (key, bool) pairs built by the static initializer at
# vaddr/file offset 0x7e3d8-0x7e5a6 (stock ZX300 2.02 and A50 1.02, same addresses), inserted into the
# QMap<int,bool> at [Feature object + 0x18]. Each value is one "strb.w rX, [sp, #0x54 + 8*key]";
# on ZX300 r2 = 0 and r3 = 1, on A50 r1 = 0 and r3 = 1. "getter" = the method that reads the key.
# name/readers: from Q_PROPERTY wrappers and from __FILE__ strings near the callers (partial).
# The table is also read directly, without the getters, by 0x151874(key): creators use it with keys 0, 1, 2, 32, 36, 43.

column5: Language Study (isAvailableLangStudy / hasFeatureLanguageStudy); also read straight from the table by 0x151874 for the screen creator (0x309aac). Table entry patched to 1 at file offset 0x7e3f1
